item.title: Building Your Personal Council of Experts
item.description:
Introduction

My council of experts is three (or more) AI personas designed to argue from specific perspectives such as application security, and software development and software architecture.

The idea is that when you use, for example, Claude Code or some other coding agent to generate a development plan, the council will receive the plan and debate it amongst themselves. The output from the council is returned to the coding agent, and the plan can be updated if needed.

item.title: Stop using chat interfaces for your command line interfaces!
item.description:
You are running an Nmap scan on a target, you encounter an unfamiliar service, what do you do? Alt-tab to your preferred AI, query: “what is this service and is there any known vulnerabilities?”, wait for the response, and then you continue your vulnerability research.

This workflow is fundamentally broken. We’re using AI as a glorified command line when it should be our always-on research assistant, integrated directly into our security workspace."
